title: Transformers: Fall of Cybertron
description: [DEMO] This project brings features and items from the game Transformers: fall of cybertron to Minecraft. I plan to update this project frequently.
body:
[DEMO] This project brings over features and items from Transformers fall of cybertron. It is in development and the current version is a demo. For now, the game has energon, from it you need to craft Spacebridge blocks and an activator, build a portal to transfer to cybertron. On cybertron there are two biomes with their own structures, loot and distinctive features. Rust sea and Sewerse.

This project will be updated in the future.
